ess_definition.form: Maynard Smith two-condition (pure-strategy, single-population, possibly asymmetric A)

excluded_types.MirrorBot: (MirrorBot, MirrorBot) is non-terminating in Critch et al. 2022; MirrorBot is excluded upstream from data/payoff_matrix.csv.

(CupodBot, DupocBot).status: unresolved in Critch et al. 2022 (red cell in payoff_matrix.png); downstream verdicts that reference this cell are flagged as suspect

diagonal_undefined_policy.rule: If A[i,i] is non-finite, enumerate_pure_ess raises ValueError. The loader currently raises earlier; this is a defence-in-depth check.
diagonal_undefined_policy.reason_currently_inactive: MirrorBot excluded; no diagonal sentinel survives the loader.

lower_triangle_handling.input_state: data/payoff_matrix.csv is a full square matrix; no blank entries in the lower triangle.
lower_triangle_handling.action_taken: loader resolves blanks via configured undefined_outcomes and transposes the action pair for the lower triangle; pair-symmetry is not re-derived here.

tolerance.rationale: payoffs are exact combinations of {b, -c, b-c, 0}; tolerance guards against float-arithmetic noise only
